screens.title: Ask · the request and its options

messages.name: hello
messages.summary: Device introduces itself: protocol version, board, capabilities

messages.name: welcome
messages.summary: Daemon answers with host info, wall-clock time and device settings

fields.note: replies  quick replies, each <= 24 chars (proto 0.4); present = the
fields.name: replies

fields.note: voice    the daemon transcribes audio_* and answers with transcript
fields.name: voice

fields.note: keys     the daemon decodes kb_stroke into kb_cands and types them
fields.name: keys

messages.name: snapshot
messages.summary: Full list of sessions, plus events missed while disconnected

messages.name: session_upd
messages.summary: One session changed: a delta, only the changed keys

fields.note: sid   daemon-assigned, stable for session lifetime
fields.name: sid

fields.note: host  host index: 0 = the daemon's own PC, 1.. = remote hosts (REMOTE.md)
fields.name: host

fields.note: hn    remote host name ≤ 16 chars; only with host != 0, only to devices with proto ≥ 0.2
fields.name: hn

fields.note: snz   snoozed until (unix); 0 = not snoozed. Keys 13-16 only to devices with proto ≥ 0.3
fields.name: snz

fields.note: ntf   "notify when done" armed; the daemon clears it in the delta that enters done/error
fields.name: ntf

fields.note: n     tool steps in the current turn (resets on a new prompt)
fields.name: n

fields.note: ok    result of step n; absent while it runs
fields.name: ok

fields.note: q     the agent's closing question when its turn ended, <= 120 chars; "" = none (proto 0.5)
fields.name: q

fields.note: rp    answers to q for the Reply list, <= 24 chars each; [] = none (proto 0.5)
fields.name: rp

fields.note: eta   a job's expected total run time in seconds (median of its earlier runs);
fields.name: eta

fields.note: exit  a job's exit status (0-255), sent with the delta that enters done / error
fields.name: exit

fields.note: ctx   context window used, percent 0-100; 255 = unknown (GAUGES.md). Keys 21-25
fields.name: ctx

fields.note: mdl   the model's short name, <= 16 chars ("Opus 4.7"); "" = unknown
fields.name: mdl

fields.note: pr    the open pull request of the session's branch; 0 = none (withheld under privacy meta)
fields.name: pr

fields.note: prs   its review state; sent with pr
fields.name: prs

fields.note: hush  only in the delta that enters done / error, only to devices with proto >= 0.12
fields.name: hush

fields.note: fc    files the turn changed (>= 1; absent = not known / none seen). Keys 30-34 only to
fields.name: fc

fields.note: la    lines added in the turn, sent with lr; absent = not known
fields.name: la

fields.note: tp    the turn's last recognised test run: true passed, false failed; absent = unknown
fields.name: tp

fields.note: dur   the turn's length in seconds, prompt to stop
fields.name: dur

fields.note: qd    the message queued for this session (proto 0.17, PROTOCOL.md §4b): the
fields.name: qd

messages.name: gone
messages.summary: A session ended and left the list

messages.name: attention
messages.summary: An agent needs you: approval, question, error or done

fields.note: acts   actions the device may offer
fields.name: acts

fields.note: exp    unix time after which to drop
fields.name: exp

fields.note: grant_mask  bit i set = opts[i] grants permission (approve-class: hold to commit)
fields.name: grant_mask

fields.note: left   ms left in the answer window when this message was sent (ANSWER-WINDOW.md);
fields.name: left

fields.note: win    the whole answer window in ms (left / win = the part still to run)
fields.name: win

fields.note: len    the full text's length in bytes, sent when `text` is a cut preview: the
fields.name: len

fields.note: hush   no buzz, glow or reminders for this request: the user is looking at its terminal
fields.name: hush

fields.note: rule   the standing rule the device may grant with this request, exactly as Claude Code
fields.name: rule

fields.note: scope  where it is saved, a rule_scope value. A uint, not the enum, so that a value a
fields.name: scope

fields.note: wide   the rule ends in a wildcard: it matches more than this exact request
fields.name: wide

messages.name: clear
messages.summary: An attention request was answered elsewhere or expired

messages.name: cmd
messages.summary: A user action: focus, approve, deny, reply, snooze...

fields.note: rid   (dictate: the card the transcript answers, proto 0.8)
fields.name: rid

fields.note: arg   snooze minutes, reply option index, quiet secs
fields.name: arg

fields.note: rh  with cmd_op_approve (proto 0.13): also save the request's standing rule. FNV-1a 32 of
fields.name: rh

fields.note: q   with cmd_op_type / cmd_op_dictate (proto 0.17): queue the message if the session cannot
fields.name: q

messages.name: result
messages.summary: Outcome of a command: ok or a reason it failed

fields.note: pos   only in answers to cmd_op_scroll
fields.name: pos

messages.name: detail
messages.summary: Full text for the detail screen

fields.note: off    byte offset of this chunk in the full text
fields.name: off

fields.note: total  the full text's length in bytes (<= 4096)
fields.name: total

messages.name: cfg
messages.summary: Device settings: privacy, alert mode, brightness

messages.name: batt
messages.summary: Battery percentage and charging state

messages.name: ping
messages.summary: Link-liveness probe

messages.name: pong
messages.summary: Answer to a ping

messages.name: log
messages.summary: A device log line

messages.name: audio_start
messages.summary: Voice capture begins (reserved)

messages.name: audio
messages.summary: A chunk of encoded audio (reserved)

messages.name: audio_end
messages.summary: Voice capture ends (reserved)

fields.note: text      "" when nothing was heard (or the recording failed); <= 2047 bytes (proto >= 0.16), else <= 255
fields.name: text

fields.note: autosend_ms  0: never; the device sends only on the user's hold (cmd_op_dictate)
fields.name: autosend_ms

messages.name: transcript
messages.summary: Speech-to-text result (reserved)

fields.note: text      "" when nothing was heard (or the recording failed); <= 2047 bytes (proto >= 0.16), else <= 255
fields.name: text

fields.note: autosend_ms  0: never; the device sends only on the user's hold (cmd_op_dictate)
fields.name: autosend_ms

messages.name: kb_start
messages.summary: KEYS: keyboard opens, with its key rectangles

fields.note: kid    one per opening of the keyboard; a repeat with the same kid swaps the layer
fields.name: kid

fields.note: keys   per key 10 B LE: u16 cp, i16 x, i16 y, u16 w, u16 h (top-left, px)
fields.name: keys

messages.name: kb_stroke
messages.summary: KEYS: the touch points of one swiped word

fields.note: seq    stroke number within kid, from 1
fields.name: seq

fields.note: pts    per point 6 B LE: i16 x, i16 y, u16 t_ms since touch-down
fields.name: pts

messages.name: kb_cands
messages.summary: KEYS: decoded word candidates and which one was typed

fields.note: typed  index of the candidate now in the terminal (absent: none typed)
fields.name: typed

messages.name: usage
messages.summary: Plan usage: the 5-hour and weekly windows, their resets and the pace (GAUGES.md)

fields.note: at    when the daemon last read these figures (unix); the device ages them from here
fields.name: at

fields.note: h5o   at the current pace the 5-hour window runs out at (unix); absent = not before it resets
fields.name: h5o

fields.note: wko   at the current pace the weekly window runs out at (unix)
fields.name: wko

messages.name: fw_begin
messages.summary: Firmware update: opens (or resumes, or with size 0 stops) a signed image transfer

fields.note: size   the image's length in bytes; 0 = stop the transfer in progress
fields.name: size

fields.note: sha    SHA-256 of the whole image: a begin naming the image already in progress
fields.name: sha

fields.note: ver    the image's version (its app description), <= 32 chars, for the screen
fields.name: ver

messages.name: fw_chunk
messages.summary: Firmware update: 2 KB of the image at an offset

fields.note: off    byte offset of this chunk in the image
fields.name: off

messages.name: fw_ack
messages.summary: Firmware update: go / done / busy / bad / fail / stopped, and the next offset wanted

fields.note: next   bytes received and written so far: the offset the device wants next
fields.name: next

fields.note: msg    why, for busy / bad / fail / stopped, <= 48 chars
fields.name: msg

messages.summary: Debug: the current screen and visible labels

roles.when: A session you armed with Notify when done (or are watching) finishes
An agent asks a question or needs your approval
An approval hold completes and the answer goes out (rises)
A deny or stop hold completes and the answer goes out (falls)

haptic_meaning.detent: A click each time the rim scrub crosses into another segment
haptic_meaning.hold_ramp: Pulses grow longer and the gaps shorter while the approve hold fills
haptic_meaning.deny_ramp: Pulses shrink and the gaps grow while the deny hold fills
haptic_meaning.reply_sent: A question option went out: three ticks
haptic_meaning.tick: A light acknowledgement of a button selection
haptic_meaning.approved: Approve was sent: one long pulse
haptic_meaning.denied: Deny was sent: two medium pulses
haptic_meaning.reject: A command could not be sent: three short pulses
haptic_meaning.hello: Link up: proves the motor path, even in silent mode
haptic_meaning.question: An agent is asking a question
haptic_meaning.scroll_stop: SCROLL reached the bottom or the top of the scrollback: one thud
haptic_meaning.quiet_toggled: Quiet mode turned on, extended or off: two spaced pulses
